description: Header file defining the MidiManagerAndroid class, which manages MIDI devices and ports on Android, including JNI interactions and device port management.

classes.name: MidiManagerAndroid
classes.description: A subclass of MidiManager for Android M or newer, managing MIDI devices and ports, JNI callbacks, and synchronization.

methods.name: MidiManagerAndroid
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MIDI manager with a given service.

methods.name: StartInitialization
methods.description: Starts the MIDI manager initialization process.

methods.name: DispatchSendMidiData
methods.description: Sends MIDI data to a specified port with a timestamp.

methods.name: OnReceivedData
methods.description: Callback when MIDI data is received from a port.

methods.name: OnInitialized
methods.description: Called from Java when MIDI devices are initialized.

methods.name: OnInitializationFailed
methods.description: Called from Java when MIDI initialization fails.

methods.name: OnAttached
methods.description: Called from Java when a MIDI device is attached.

methods.name: OnDetached
methods.description: Called from Java when a MIDI device is detached.

methods.name: AddInputPortAndroid
methods.description: Adds an input port to a device.

methods.name: AddOutputPortAndroid
methods.description: Adds an output port to a device.
